product_metadata.title: Farberware Nonstick Bakeware Set, Nonstick Cookie Sheets / Baking Sheets - 2 Piece, Gray
features: DURABLE COOKIE SHEETS: Heavy-duty construction of this bakeware set meets the demands of the busiest kitchens to keeping to baking, oven roasting and toasting for years
NONSTICK BAKEWARE: Nonstick inside and out, these cookie sheets by Farberware delivers great food release with quick cleanup so you can enjoy your baked or roasted goods quicker!
HIGH HEAT BAKING PAN: The cookie sheets are oven safe to 450 degrees F, the perfect temperature for most baking, oven roasting and toasting
QUALITY BAKEWARE: These cookie pans and every other piece of Farberware(r) Bakeware dependably uphold a distinguished tradition of reliability, value and performance to keep you baking for years
NOTE: Industry standards for bakeware lists cooking surface area, not the overall dimensions in the title of the product
description: Bake batch after batch of chocolate chip, lemon shortbread and oatmeal raisin cookies using the Farberware Nonstick Bakeware 10-Inch x 15-Inch Cookie Pan Set. With every piece of sturdy and dependable bakeware, Farberware upholds the tradition of reliability, value and performance provided to generations of home bakers for more than a century. These durable cookie pans feature heavy-duty steel construction that reliably resists warping and heats evenly to brown beautifully and help reduce hot spots that can burn baked goods. Nonstick inside and out delivers great food release and makes cleanup quick, even after baking a gooey batch of caramel fudge cookies. Oven safe to 450°F, these nonstick cookie pans make an ideal addition to the cake, muffin and specialty baking pans in the Farberware Bakeware collection. Double up your cookie pan count with the Farberware Nonstick Bakeware 10-Inch x 15-Inch Cookie Pan Set.
